Read me: Tombi! cut Civilization towns - palettes, residents and props
Shared research sheet. Yellow columns are for you to fill in (identifications, notes, sources).
Palettes: every resident palette row of each town's main CLUT file (16 colours each, shown as coloured cells).
Residents: every resident record of the code (I0NFO2 NPC sets 0D/0E/0F/10), with subtype, position and behaviour.
Props: every prop record (the yellow P# squares on the plans), same P numbers as the plans.
Each CLUTnn.GAM has 256 rows of 16 colours. Which row a resident uses is in its lost sprite table, not in surviving code.
Rows 32 apart are variants of the same resident (e.g. A11 rows 4 / 36 / 68). Columns 0 and 12-15 (row % 16) are shared HUD/scenery rows and are left out.
"Also in" lists every other civ CLUT file/row holding the exact same 16 colours.
Confidence: Confirmed (proven against disc data or TCRF), Probable, FMV match (matched to a BUNMEI.STR figure), Guess, Community ID (not verified yet).
Positions are world coordinates (1 unit = 1 px of the town picture). Room 0 = outdoors, n = inside house Hn. Same subtype = same sprite and animation set.
Resident numbers (#) and prop numbers (P#) match the "who goes where" plans.
